verdict.line: You lose if Kled catches you with his 800-range Q hook while Skaarl is fully mounted; you win almost every trade once Skaarl's health bar empties and he dismounts.

brief.thesis: Kled's entire threat level is tied to Skaarl's health bar. While mounted he has an 800-range hook (Q), a four-attack speed burst (W), and a repeatable dash (E) that chain into the early all-in behind his lane and solo-kill advantage. The instant Skaarl depletes, Kled dismounts, his Q becomes a self-knockback Pocket Pistol instead of a hook, and he deals less damage to champions — the exact window Volibear's stun-and-heal kit is built to punish.

theirWindow.when: Skaarl mounted, Q and E both up
theirWindow.what: He can hook you from 800 range with Q, yank you in, then dash with E (Jousting) and pop W (Violent Tendencies) for four fast attacks. Don't stand in his Q line without minions to block it, and don't extend past 800 range without a way out.

yourWindow.what: Kled's Q is now Pocket Pistol — a self-knockback gun blast, not a hook — and he hits champions for less. Walk up and chain Q (Thundering Smash) into E (Sky Splitter) into W (Frenzied Maul) recast; this is your cleanest kill window all lane.

start.why: The extra AP and mana regen feed Volibear's frequent W (Frenzied Maul, 5s cooldown) pokes and the magic damage portion of his passive, letting you whittle Skaarl's health without committing to melee range against his Q hook.

boots.why: Kled's W (Violent Tendencies) is four fast physical autos, and his E (Jousting) and solo-kill pressure are all auto-attack reliant — the flat damage reduction directly cuts his burst.

core.why: Builds toward attack speed and on-hit damage that scales your passive's bonus magic damage and keeps W cycling faster.
Attack speed plus cooldown refund on takedowns, which matters since your W/Q loop wants to be back up fast after every all-in window.
Sustain and tankiness for extended trades, letting you out-heal his poke while Skaarl is mounted and chip away toward the dismount.

situational.when: kled's violent tendencies auto-attacks are shredding your health in extended trades
the enemy team is stacking magic damage alongside kled
kled is splitting push and you need wave clear and chase to catch him
teamfights are dragging on and you need extra sustain and poke

runes.keystoneWhy: Volibear's passive already stacks attack speed on attacks and abilities, and Lethal Tempo compounds that ramp so your W (Frenzied Maul) on-hit and recast-heal loop fires faster the longer a mounted-vs-dismounted fight drags on.

summoners.why: This lane is measured as defensive with Kled holding the solo-kill edge, so Exhaust (57.1% win rate on this pairing) blunts his Q-hook-into-E-dash-into-W burst better than a kill-focused spell. Flash+Ignite (72.6% pick) is the more common alternative if you're confident punishing his early dismount windows instead.

playing.title: Track Skaarl's health bar
playing.detail: Every decision in this lane hinges on whether Skaarl is mounted or dismounted — check it before every trade, not just when you're already in range.

playing.title: Don't walk into Q range
playing.detail: Kled's Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) hooks from 800 range and yanks you toward him if it shackles. Stay outside that range or behind minions when Skaarl is still mounted.

playing.title: Poke with W, don't chase
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul's 5s cooldown lets you re-engage quickly; land it, back off, and only recast on the same target for the bonus damage and heal when you're safe to follow up.

playing.title: All-in the moment he dismounts
playing.detail: Once Skaarl depletes, Kled's Q becomes a self-knockback Pocket Pistol and he deals less damage to champions. Chain Q (Thundering Smash) into E (Sky Splitter) into W immediately.

playing.title: Hold Q for his E dash
playing.detail: Thundering Smash gains speed toward its target and stuns on first attack — save it to punish his Jousting dash in or out rather than throwing it away on a standing target.

playing.title: Zone with E instead of melee
playing.detail: Sky Splitter has 1200 range and shields you if you're inside the blast; use it to contest the wave and damage Skaarl without stepping into his Q hook range.

playing.title: Respect levels 1-5
playing.detail: By level 5 Kled has his full Q/W/E combo online and Skaarl is still tanky — play for pokes and wave state, not all-ins, until you can answer his burst with your own stun-and-heal loop.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — why each window opens and how to play around Skaarl's mount state — is my own tactical read, not measured data.
